title: 皮ふの下に骨と筋肉 ― 楽譜から計算して弾く3Dの手 #Shorts
description:
楽譜から両手の動きを計算して、3D の手がピアノを弾く。骨の長さは測った研究の値、皮ふは骨と筋肉の模型から作り、届かない音は「押せなかった」と正直に出す。ブラウザのアプリ「ピアノを弾く手」（技術検証）から。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/piano-hand/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

おもな出どころ: Parncutt ほか (1997) Music Perception 14(4)、Buryanov & Kotiuk (2010) International Journal of Morphology 28(3)、Zhu ほか (2013) ほか

音楽: アプリの中で合成したピアノの音です。

#ピアノ #運指 #3DCG #まなびラボ

en.title: Bones and muscles under the skin ― 3D hands that play from the score #Shorts
en.description:
3D hands play the piano with both-hand movements computed from the score. Bone lengths come from measured studies, the skin is built from a model of bones and muscles, and notes out of reach are honestly shown as "could not press". From "Hands at the Piano", a browser app (a tech demo).

App (switch the app to English with the EN button): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/piano-hand/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

Main sources: Parncutt et al. (1997) Music Perception 14(4), Buryanov & Kotiuk (2010) International Journal of Morphology 28(3), Zhu et al. (2013), and others

Music: piano sounds synthesized in the app.

#Piano #3DCG #Shorts
